pack: Last 5 Year Top 50 One Word Substitutions
title: Last 5 Year Top 50 OWS: Set 2 (Q26 to Q50)
subtitle: Hangar to Biopsy

words.hindi: विमानशाला (हवाई जहाज़ों को रखने और मरम्मत करने की बड़ी इमारत)
words.meaning: A large building where aircraft are kept, repaired, or maintained.
words.example: The Air Force fighter jets were parked inside the reinforced hangar.

words.hindi: कीचड़ या उसमें मौजूद कार्बनिक पदार्थ खाने वाला जीव
words.meaning: An organism that feeds on mud or the organic matter present in it.
words.example: Earthworms and certain aquatic worms are limivorous creatures.

words.hindi: अप्रभावित (जिस पर आलोचना, दबाव या भावनाओं का कोई असर न हो)
words.meaning: Not affected or influenced by something, especially criticism, pressure, or emotions.
words.example: A focused officer remains impervious to baseless criticism.

words.hindi: छिपकर दूसरों की निजी बातें सुनने वाला व्यक्ति
words.meaning: A person who secretly listens to the private conversations of others.
words.example: Never discuss confidential matters near doors where an eavesdropper might stand.

words.hindi: मिलनसार / झुंड या समूह में रहने वाला
words.meaning: An animal that naturally lives in a herd or group rather than alone; sociable person.
words.example: Elephants and deer are naturally gregarious animals.

words.hindi: हमनाम (किसी दूसरे व्यक्ति जैसा ही नाम रखने वाला)
words.meaning: A person having the same name as another.
words.example: He met his namesake during the first day of college orientation.

words.hindi: बोलने या लिखने में लंबे और कठिन शब्दों का प्रयोग करने वाला व्यक्ति
words.meaning: A person who is fond of using long, complicated words in speech or writing.
words.example: His sesquipedalian vocabulary made the simple essay hard to read.

words.hindi: खगोल विज्ञान (तारों, ग्रहों और अंतरिक्ष का वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन)
words.meaning: The scientific study of stars, planets and space.
words.example: Ancient Indian scholars made great discoveries in mathematics and astronomy.

words.hindi: आनुवंशिकी (माता-पिता से बच्चों में आने वाले गुणों और विविधता का अध्ययन)
words.meaning: The study of the hereditary transmission and variation of inherited characteristics.
words.example: Gregor Mendel is known as the father of modern genetics.

words.hindi: रक्तचापमापी (ब्लड प्रेशर मापने वाला यंत्र)
words.meaning: An instrument used to measure blood pressure.
words.example: The doctor wrapped the sphygmomanometer cuff around the patient's arm.

words.hindi: प्रलय (पूरी दुनिया का अंतिम और पूर्ण विनाश)
words.meaning: The complete final destruction of the world, as described in religious texts.
words.example: The sci-fi movie depicts survival after a nuclear apocalypse.

words.hindi: महाकाव्य (वीरों के कारनामों और साहसिक घटनाओं पर लिखी लंबी कविता)
words.meaning: A long narrative poem, typically detailing the heroic deeds and adventures of a legendary figure.
words.example: The Ramayana and the Mahabharata are the two greatest epics of India.

words.hindi: खगोलशास्त्री (तारों, ग्रहों और अंतरिक्ष का अध्ययन करने वाला वैज्ञानिक)
words.meaning: A person who studies the stars and planets.
words.example: Aryabhata was a renowned ancient Indian mathematician and astronomer.

words.hindi: विष विज्ञान (ज़हर और उसके असर का वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन)
words.meaning: The branch of science concerned with the nature, effects, and detection of poisons.
words.example: Forensic experts rely on toxicology reports to detect poisoning.

words.hindi: स्वैच्छिक (अपनी मर्ज़ी से बिना किसी दबाव या वेतन के किया गया कार्य)
words.meaning: An action done by one's own free will, without being forced or paid.
words.example: Blood donation is a noble voluntary service to society.

words.hindi: कॉपीराइट / स्वत्वाधिकार (किताब, संगीत या कलाकृति को छापने और बेचने का कानूनी अधिकार)
words.meaning: The legal right to be the only one to reproduce, publish, and sell a book, musical recording, or artistic work.
words.example: The author holds the copyright to all chapters of this textbook.

words.hindi: शरणार्थी (युद्ध या अत्याचार के कारण अपना देश छोड़ने वाला व्यक्ति)
words.meaning: A person who is forced to leave their country because of war or persecution.
words.example: International agencies set up relief camps for war refugees.

words.hindi: बर्फीला तूफ़ान (तेज़ हवाओं और भारी बर्फबारी वाला तूफ़ान)
words.meaning: A severe snowstorm with high winds and low visibility.
words.example: Flights were cancelled due to a heavy blizzard in the mountains.

words.hindi: विषुव (साल का वह समय जब दिन और रात बराबर होते हैं)
words.meaning: The time of year when day and night are of equal length.
words.example: The vernal equinox occurs around March 21 every year.

words.hindi: पुस्तक या अध्याय की शुरुआत में लिखा गया संक्षिप्त उद्धरण (Quotation)
words.meaning: A short quotation at the beginning of a book or chapter to set the theme.
words.example: The author placed a famous Sanskrit shloka as the epigraph of her book.

words.hindi: बंदरगाह पर जहाज़ों से माल चढ़ाने और उतारने वाला मज़दूर
words.meaning: A labourer involved in loading and unloading ships.
words.example: Stevedores used heavy cranes to unload cargo containers at Mumbai port.

words.hindi: परोपकारिता (निःस्वार्थ भाव से दूसरों की भलाई करना)
words.meaning: Selfless concern for the well-being of others.
words.example: She donated her prize money to the orphanage out of pure altruism.

words.hindi: अन्नागार / अनाज रखने का गोदाम
words.meaning: A place or storehouse where threshed grain is stored.
words.example: After a good harvest, the village granary was full of wheat.

words.hindi: स्वदेश वापस भेजना (किसी व्यक्ति को उसके अपने देश वापस भेजना)
words.meaning: To send someone back to his or her own country.
words.example: The embassy arranged special flights to repatriate stranded citizens.

words.hindi: जीवित शरीर से ऊतक (Tissue) का छोटा नमूना लेकर की जाने वाली मेडिकल जाँच
words.meaning: A procedure where a piece of tissue or sample of cells from a living body is removed for medical examination.
words.example: The pathologist confirmed the diagnosis after examining the biopsy sample.
